description: By Kathryn Depauw Aug 7, 2024TRAVERSE CITY — A plan to build income-qualified apartments to attract teachers to the region got a $5 million boost from Michigan’s governor.Representatives from Traverse City Area Public Schools, Michigan Education Association and state political offices gathered Tuesday at Blair Elementary School to announce a grant aimed at initial phases to build housing for school staff, and possibly first responders.

title: Blair Township educator housing project gets $5M | Betsy Coffia
